mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% over the next month raises investor expectations for future rate hikes, which reduces the present value of equities and produces negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are non-negative when CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3, or inflation decays quickly with no persistent rate hike anticipation.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS labor cost index exceeding 0.5% signals wage pressures that outpace productivity (INDPRO), prompting higher labor cost assumptions and a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > INDPRO + 0.5 in the following month
failure_condition: Rank IC > 0.05 over 60-day window or PAYEMS growth ≤ INDPRO growth for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST retail sales exceeding 2% in the following 20-day window indicates strengthening consumer demand, which elevates equity valuations and drives positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative despite consistent monthly HOUST growth > 2% over the next 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly decline in GDPC1 GDP (billions) of over 2% in the current quarter followed by a rebound in the next quarter is associated with a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return due to market anticipation of economic weakness.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < previous quarter by >2% for 3 months then GDPC1 > previous quarter in next month
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive when GDP rebounds as predicted, or GDP contraction <2% for 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in FEDFUNDS above 5% in the following month triggers a risk-off reaction as markets price in higher borrowing costs, producing a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 5 in the next trading day
failure_condition: 5-day returns are non-negative when FEDFUNDS spikes are not followed by market stress indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in UNRATE below 4% for two consecutive months reduces the labor cost discount, improving firm valuation and producing a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative when UNRATE remains below 4% for 4 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO rises faster than PAYEMS by more than 1% in the next month, it indicates productivity outpacing wage growth, which compresses profit margins and yields a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > PAYEMS + 1 in the following month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive when wage growth outpaces productivity for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A regime shift from monetary tightening to holding (FEDFUNDS < 4.25% for two months) coincides with a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as markets anticipate rate stability and lower risk premia.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative when FEDFUNDS remains above 4.25 for the next 6 months.
